args.summary: The v2.3.1 deploy of checkout-api failed health checks in production. As remediation, the service was rolled back in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Post-rollback status is healthy with an error rate of 0.2%. Root cause investigation of v2.3.1 is needed before any redeploy.
args.title: checkout-api rollback to v2.3.0 after unhealthy v2.3.1 deploy

trace.final:
All done. Summary:

1. **Diagnosis**: Checked deployment history — v2.3.1 was the latest deploy and was unhealthy in production; v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production.
2. **Rollback**: Rolled checkout-api back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Verified the service is now **healthy** with a low error rate (0.2%).
3. **Incident**: Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** (on-call paged) documenting the failed v2.3.1 health checks, the rollback to v2.3.0 across all regions, and the need for root-cause investigation before any redeploy of v2.3.1.
